clips.title: The story
paras: Captain Stoutfist is the dwarven officer in charge of military defenses at Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. With the Dragonmaw clan pushing aggressively out of their marshland strongholds, Stoutfist coordinates defensive maneuvers and counter-offensives to ensure the vital Alliance port does not fall.

Menethil Harbor serves as the principal deepwater port connecting Ironforge and Stormwind to the marshy lowlands of the Wetlands and the sea beyond. As the town's commanding officer, Captain Stoutfist bears the heavy burden of keeping its docks, civilian populace, and garrison secure against surrounding threats. The marshlands are notoriously hazardous, but the biggest peril to the settlement is an organized surge from renegade orcs.

The Dragonmaw clan, entrenched within the Wetlands since the Second War, has begun pushing their operations directly toward the roadways and passes. By infiltrating Dun Algaz, they threaten to sever the overland lifeline connecting Loch Modan and Ironforge to Menethil Harbor. Facing a severe shortage of troops, Captain Stoutfist relies on visiting Alliance volunteers recommended by Mountaineer Valstag Ironjaw to stem the tide.
